about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Egusi Soup Nigerian Melon Seed Stew with Beef
recipes.summary: A thick, nutty ground melon seed stew with spinach and beef, traditionally eaten with pounded yam or rice.
steps: Simmer the beef in the stock with half the onion and 1 tsp salt for 25 minutes until tender and at least 71°C.
Heat the oil, fry the remaining onion for 5 minutes, then add the tomato and capsicum purée and cook 12 minutes until reduced and the oil separates.
Mix the pumpkin seeds with 1/2 cup water to a paste and drop spoonfuls into the sauce, cooking 8 minutes without stirring until set into curds.
Add the beef with its stock, chilli and dried shrimp and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the spinach for 2 minutes until wilted, cook the rice until tender and fluffy and serve alongside.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef to at least 71°C. Contains shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Suya Spiced Beef Skewers with Peanut Rub
recipes.summary: Nigerian street skewers dusted with peanut-chilli spice, served with onion, tomato and rice.
steps: Mix the peanuts, paprika, chilli, ginger, garlic powder and 1 tsp salt.
Toss the beef with the oil and two-thirds of the spice mix and thread onto metal skewers.
Grill or barbecue over high heat for 8 minutes, turning, until charred and the beef reaches 71°C.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Dust the skewers with the remaining spice and serve with the rice, onion and tomato.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef to at least 71°C. Contains peanuts. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mafe Senegalese Peanut Stew with Chicken
recipes.summary: A rich peanut and tomato stew with chicken and sweet potato, served over rice.

items: 700g chicken thigh fillets, cut into chunks

steps: Brown the chicken in the oil for 6 minutes and set aside.
Fry the onion and garlic in the same pot for 5 minutes, add the tomatoes and tomato paste and cook 6 minutes.
Whisk the peanut butter into the stock, add to the pot with the chicken, sweet potatoes and carrots.
Simmer for 25 minutes until the vegetables are tender and the chicken reaches 75°C.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy and serve with the stew.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken to 75°C in the centre. Contains peanuts. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Yassa Poulet Senegalese Lemon Onion Chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken braised under a mountain of caramelised onions with mustard and lemon, over rice.
steps: Grill the drumsticks for 12 minutes, turning, until browned and nearly cooked through.
Cook the onions in the oil for 15 minutes over medium heat until very soft and golden.
Stir in the garlic, mustard, lemon juice and stock and add the chicken and chillies.
Cover and simmer 15 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C and the sauce is thick.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy and serve with the chicken and onions.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken to 75°C at the thickest part. Contains mustard. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ndole Cameroonian Peanut and Greens Stew with Prawns
recipes.summary: A creamy peanut stew with greens and prawns, a Cameroon celebration dish.
steps: Blend the onion, garlic and ginger with a splash of water.
Fry the purée in the oil for 6 minutes until the water cooks away.
Whisk the peanut butter into the water and add with the spinach and chilli, simmering 20 minutes until the greens are soft and the sauce thickens.
Add the prawns and cook 4 minutes until pink and opaque.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy and serve with the stew.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and opaque, at least 63°C inside. Contains peanuts and shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Gomen Besiga Ethiopian Collards with Beef
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked silverbeet-style greens with beef, ginger and garlic.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil for 8 minutes and add the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and water, cover and simmer for 20 minutes until the beef is nearly tender.
Stir in the silverbeet and chilli and cook, covered, for 12 minutes until the greens are soft and the beef reaches 71°C.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy and serve alongside.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef to at least 71°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pilau ya Nyama Kenyan Spiced Beef Rice
recipes.summary: Fragrant Swahili-coast pilau with beef, cumin and cardamom, a festive staple.
steps: Fry the onions in the oil for 12 minutes until deep brown.
Add the beef, garlic, ginger and spices and brown for 8 minutes.
Add 1 cup stock, cover and simmer 25 minutes until the beef is tender and reaches 71°C.
Add the rinsed rice and remaining stock, bring to a boil, then cover and cook on low for 15 minutes until the rice is tender and fluffy.
Rest 5 minutes and fluff before serving.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef to at least 71°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lu Sipi Samoan Lamb in Coconut Cream
recipes.summary: Lamb slow-cooked in coconut cream with onion until the sauce is rich and sweet, served with rice and sweet potato.
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and ginger in a dry heavy pot for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb and water, cover and simmer for 40 minutes until the lamb is nearly tender.
Stir in the coconut cream and sweet potatoes and simmer uncovered for 25 minutes until the sauce thickens, the sweet potato is soft and the lamb reaches 71°C.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy and serve with the lamb.
notes: Food safety: cook the lamb to at least 71°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sapasui Samoan Beef Chop Suey Noodles
recipes.summary: Glass noodles tossed with beef, ginger and soy, a staple of every Samoan gathering.
steps: Soak the noodles in hot water for 8 minutes until pliable, then drain.
Fry the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil for 4 minutes, add the beef and stir-fry 4 minutes until browned.
Add the carrots, soy sauce and water and simmer 6 minutes.
Toss in the noodles for 3 minutes until tender and the beef reaches 71°C.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef to at least 71°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Kare Raisu Tofu Katsu Curry Plate
recipes.summary: Crumbed pan-fried tofu with a mild Japanese-style curry sauce over rice, fully vegan.
steps: Press the tofu on paper towels for 10 minutes to remove water.
Cook the onion, carrots and potatoes in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes, stir in the curry powder and 2 tbsp flour for 1 minute, then add the stock and soy sauce.
Simmer the sauce for 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the sauce is thick.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Dip the tofu in flour, soy milk then breadcrumbs and shallow-fry in the remaining oil for 3 minutes per side until crisp and golden. Slice and serve over the rice with the sauce.

recipes.title: Agedashi Tofu Donburi with Mushrooms
recipes.summary: Crisp-coated tofu in a savoury soy broth over rice with mushrooms and spring onion; fully vegan.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Pat the tofu dry, coat in starch and shallow-fry in the oil for 5 minutes until crisp and pale gold.
Simmer the mushrooms with the water, soy sauce and mirin for 4 minutes until soft.
Spoon the rice into bowls, top with tofu and ladle over the mushroom broth.
Scatter with spring onion and serve at once while the coating is still crisp.

recipes.title: Kimchi Dubu Jjigae Vegan-Style Tofu Stew
recipes.summary: A bubbling tofu and kimchi stew with mushrooms, finished with sesame oil.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Fry the kimchi in the sesame oil for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the water, gochujang, gochugaru, soy sauce and mushrooms and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the tofu and simmer 6 minutes until heated through, then stir in the spring onions.
Serve in the pot with the rice.

recipes.title: Gyeran Mari Rolled Omelette and Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: A neat layered omelette with carrot and spring onion over rice with soy dressing.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and stir in the carrot and spring onions.
Pour a thin layer into an oiled non-stick pan, cook until almost set, roll it up, then pour more egg and roll again, repeating until used.
Cook each layer for 2 minutes until set and the roll is firm in the centre.
Slice the roll, serve over the rice and drizzle with soy sauce, sesame oil and seeds.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until fully set. Contains egg, gluten, soy and sesame. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pad Kra Pao Tofu Holy Basil Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Stir-fried tofu with chilli, garlic and basil over rice with a fried egg; the egg can be left out for vegan.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Crush the garlic and chillies together.
Fry the tofu in 1 tbsp oil for 6 minutes until golden and set aside.
Stir-fry the garlic and chillies for 30 seconds, add the tofu, soy sauce and sugar and toss 2 minutes until glossy.
Fold in the basil, fry the eggs in the remaining oil until the whites are set, and serve everything over the rice.
notes: Food safety: fry the eggs until the whites are fully set. Contains egg, gluten and soy. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Doenjang Jjigae Korean Soybean Paste Stew
recipes.summary: A savoury fermented soybean stew with zucchini, tofu and potato.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Stir the doenjang into the water in a pot, add the potatoes and onion and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the zucchini, mushrooms, garlic and gochugaru and simmer 6 minutes until the potato is tender.
Add the tofu and spring onions for 3 minutes and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Hayashi Rice Japanese Beef and Red Wine Stew
recipes.summary: A rich beef and onion stew in a glossy tomato and demi-glace-style sauce over rice.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Melt the butter, brown the beef for 6 minutes, then add the onions and mushrooms for 8 minutes.
Stir in the flour and tomato paste for 1 minute, then add the stock, tomato sauce and worcestershire.
Simmer 25 minutes until the sauce is thick and glossy and the beef reaches 71°C.
Spoon the beef and its glossy sauce over the rice and serve straight away.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef to at least 71°C. Contains milk, gluten and fish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Japchae Korean Glass Noodle Stir-Fry with Beef
recipes.summary: Chewy sweet potato noodles stir-fried with beef and colourful vegetables in a sesame-soy glaze.
steps: Boil the noodles for 6 minutes until tender and chewy, drain and toss with 1 tbsp sesame oil.
Blanch the spinach for 1 minute, squeeze dry and season with a little soy sauce.
Stir-fry the beef with half the soy, sugar and garlic for 4 minutes until it reaches 71°C.
Stir-fry the carrot, onion and mushrooms in the remaining oil for 5 minutes.
Toss everything with the noodles, remaining soy and sugar for 2 minutes, then sprinkle with sesame seeds.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef to at least 71°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Samgyetang Ginseng Chicken and Rice Soup
recipes.summary: A whole small chicken stuffed with rice and garlic, simmered in a delicate broth.
steps: Rinse the rice, then stuff each chicken with rice, and garlic and tie the legs together.
Place in a pot with the water and ginger, bring to a boil, then simmer, covered, for 50 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C at the thickest part.
Season the broth with 1 tsp salt and ladle around each chicken.
Serve scattered with spring onions.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken to 75°C at the thickest part, including the stuffing. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Yukgaejang Spicy Shredded Beef Soup
recipes.summary: A fiery brisket and vegetable soup, with plenty of spring onion and greens.
steps: Simmer the brisket in the water for 45 minutes until tender and at least 71°C, then lift out and shred.
Fry the garlic and gochugaru in the sesame oil for 1 minute.
Return the beef to the broth with the garlic mix, soy sauce, sprouts, spinach and spring onions and simmer 8 minutes.
Stream in the beaten egg and stir until it forms strands and sets, about 1 minute.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef to at least 71°C and the egg until set. Contains egg, gluten, soy and sesame. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Tteokbokki Korean Chilli Rice Cakes with Eggs
recipes.summary: Chewy rice cakes in a sweet, spicy gochujang sauce with fish cake and boiled egg.
steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and peel.
Bring the water, gochujang, gochugaru, sugar and soy sauce to a boil in a wide pan until the sauce is smooth.
Add the rice cakes and fish cake and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring, until the rice cakes are soft and chewy and the sauce is thick.
Add the eggs and spring onions for the last 2 minutes.
notes: Food safety: hard-boil the eggs until the yolk is firm. Contains egg, fish, gluten and soy. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Bobotie Cape Malay Spiced Mince with Egg Custard
recipes.summary: South African curried mince baked under an egg custard topping, served with rice and chutney.
steps: Fry the onions in the oil for 6 minutes, add the mince and cook 8 minutes until browned.
Squeeze the milk from the bread (keep the milk), mash the bread and stir into the mince with the curry powder, jam, vinegar, sultanas and 1 tsp salt.
Press into a baking dish and bake at 180°C for 20 minutes.
Whisk the saved milk with the eggs, pour over the top, add the bay leaves and bake 20 minutes until the custard is set and the mince reaches 75°C.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy and serve with the bobotie.
notes: Food safety: cook the mince to 75°C in the centre and the custard until set. Contains milk, egg and gluten. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
